_comment: CC0 assets for T3.4. Downloaded by src/assets/fetch_assets.py into paths.ASSETS/<source>/<id>/. Poly Haven models: glTF (.gltf + .bin + textures/ at the stated resolution). Poly Haven's glTF does NOT reference the opacity map of foliage (materials say MASK/BLEND but the diffuse is an alpha-less JPG), so alpha_map (and translucency_map where offered) are fetched into textures/ and must be wired to the material's alpha by the scene builder. Some rocks ship LOD0..LOD3 meshes in one glTF; use *_LOD0. Poly Haven textures: diffuse/normal(GL)/roughness/AO as JPG, displacement as 16-bit PNG. ambientCG: 2K-JPG zip, listed maps extracted next to it. Thumbnails have no size in the API, so they are checked for presence only.

categories.dragonstone: 2 pitted brown/red rock (dragon stone / lava rock stand-in)
categories.plants: 7 plants that can pass as aquatic
